target.title: docs: document optional workspace capability inventory records
target.body:
Closes #76074

## What Problem This Solves

Advanced workspaces can contain local bridges, devices, services, and queues whose existence and ownership are difficult for agents to discover without scattering notes across workspace files. Duplicating operating procedures in those notes can also create competing sources of truth with skills and plugins.

## Why This Change Was Made

This documents `capabilities/*.md` as an optional, inventory-only pattern: records contain concise metadata and point to authoritative workspace skill or plugin documentation. The inventory is linked intentionally from `TOOLS.md`; it is not a bootstrap input, runtime extension, operating-instruction surface, or change to Gateway access, auth, routing, or tool policy.

## User Impact

Operators of advanced local setups can maintain a small index that tells agents which workspace-specific integrations exist, who owns them, where the authoritative instructions live, and which read-only availability check to use. There is no runtime behavior change, automatic discovery, or new permission surface; reusable procedures remain in workspace skills, runtime integrations in plugins, and shared distribution in ClawHub.

## Evidence

Rebased onto `upstream/main` at `ec01949d862`. The net diff is limited to five documentation files: the inventory page, its workspace section, navigation, glossary entry, and generated docs map.

Local validation:

- `git diff --check upstream/main..HEAD` — passed
- `node scripts/docs-list.js` — passed
- `node scripts/format-docs.mjs --check` — 730 files clean
- targeted `markdownlint-cli2` — 0 issues
- `node scripts/check-docs-mdx.mjs docs README.md` — 746 files passed
- `DOCS_I18N_GLOSSARY_BASE=upstream/main node scripts/check-docs-i18n-glossary.mjs` — passed
- `node scripts/docs-link-audit.mjs` — 6,156 internal links checked, 0 broken
- `node scripts/generate-docs-map.mjs --check` — up to date

The aggregate `pnpm check:docs` wrapper could not start locally because dependency reconciliation on current `main` reports a missing optional `@lydell/node-pty` lockfile entry, and this host has Node 22.22.2 while the repository now requires at least 22.22.3. Exact-head GitHub Actions is the authoritative full-suite result.
